headline: See where your business is losing money, then stop it
sub: Clearer numbers on takings, stock and time, and fewer jobs that cost more than they earn. I improve the systems behind the business so you can see what is going on.

cards.title: Takings in one place
cards.text: Sales and takings are gathered into one view, so you know how the week went.

cards.title: Stock you can see
cards.text: Stock totals are tracked, so you spot what is running low or sitting unsold.

cards.title: Jobs that pay their way
cards.text: Time and costs are lined up against what you charged, so you can see which jobs earn their keep.

closing: Ready to see where your money goes?
